purpose: Consent-aware hospital stories about care pathways, staff work, patient safety, access, and quality.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Protect patient privacy and consent; define population and avoid diagnosis or individualized treatment advice.
